520	Again: so that after 120 years of Rav Shach there will be someone fit to instruct others to go out
521	to work, that is why I stay.
522	Because if I go out to work, I will not be a Torah scholar.
523	And if I am not a Torah scholar, I will not be able to give the instruction to go out to work.
524	So that is why he stayed.
525	Now Rav Shach, on Purim, a few students from the yeshiva came to him.
526	And they sat with him, words of Torah, and there was joy.
527	Suddenly Rav Shlomo Lorincz walked in.
528	Do you remember him?
529	He was a Knesset member, he was also a deputy minister, he had...
530	What?
531	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
532	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
533	He walked in, and the students immediately understood: Rav Lorincz came in, a Knesset member, so they have to
534	give up their seats, in any case, a distinguished man, he came in.
535	So they got up to clear the place for him to sit, he came with mishloach manot.
536	Rav Shach signaled to them: sit.
537	He took Rav Lorincz to the kitchen.
538	He gave him a different mishloach manot, accompanied him outside, did everything fully.
539	He came back and told them how important he is, and how much he brings merit to the many, and much depends on him.
540	But yeshiva students who sit and learn, their level is greater,
541	and their standing is more important.
542	And he stayed to speak with those young students, to show them that they are more important than that Knesset
543	member.
544	And therefore, the Gemara says in tractate Megillah, page 16b:
545	Torah study is greater than saving lives. What does it mean that Torah study is greater than
546	saving lives?
547	Ateret Zahav says, Yoreh De'ah, siman 251, small subsection 6, laws of tzedakah:
548	Imagine now some suicide terrorist, may HaShem have mercy, wants to enter
549	the mall in, say, Malcha Mall,
550	wants to enter the mall and carry out an attack, and the security guard discovers it, immediately leaps
551	on him, brings him down to the floor, ties his hands, let's make it a story, yes,
552	okay, and saved all the people in Malcha Mall, they will let him light
553	a torch on Independence Day and he will receive, I don't know how you say it, some medal
554	of honor. But a yeshiva student, or a person who sits here and learns
555	in the synagogue on that very same street, says Ateret Zahav, in heaven he receives a much
556	higher reward than that security guard who saved hundreds of people. You have
557	that, how do you say it, the plumber,
558	that plumber, yes, from the plane, I don't remember his name,
559	that plumber who saved the 170 passengers there on the plane.
